entities.name: Jon
entities.description: A former banker who lost his job on 19 January 2023 and spent 2023 building a dance studio of his own. Contemporary dance has been his passion and his stress relief since childhood; he danced in a crew that won a local competition in 2022. He closed his bank account for the business in April, was mentored by a businessman in June, opened the studio on 20 June 2023, and by 21 July was covering expenses with a temp job while looking for investors. Friends with Gina, who lost her job the same month and was building a clothing business in parallel.

entities.name: Gina
entities.description: Lost her job at DoorDash in January 2023 and built a clothing business from it — a physical store first, then an online one that opened on 16 March 2023, then a new ordering website in July. She competed in dance as a teenager and won a regional first place at fifteen; dance is still how she manages stress. In May 2023 she was accepted onto a part-time fashion internship at an international company, and in July fashion editors approached her. She offered to make content and run social media for Jon's studio.

entities.name: DoorDash
entities.description: Gina's employer until January 2023, when she lost her job there. That loss is what she credits for starting her own clothing business.

entities.name: Jon's dance studio
entities.description: The business Jon started after losing his banking job in January 2023: a place to teach dance and give dancers somewhere to express themselves. He searched for premises through the spring, wanted a downtown space with natural light and Marley flooring, offered classes, workshops and one-to-one mentoring, and held a grand opening on 20 June 2023. By 21 July 2023 it was on tenuous ground: he was pitching investors, building an online platform for it, and paying expenses from a temp job, with Gina helping on social media.

entities.name: Gina's clothing business
entities.description: The business Gina built after losing her job at DoorDash: a physical store first, an online store from 16 March 2023, and a new ordering website around 14 July 2023. She ran an ad campaign, signed a wholesaler, collaborated with a local artist, ran offers and promotions, made a styling video, released a limited-edition line around 14 June 2023, and was approached by fashion editors around 2 July 2023.

entities.name: contemporary dance
entities.description: The dance style both Jon and Gina name as their favourite. Jon calls it expressive and powerful; Gina's competition-winning piece at fifteen was contemporary.

entities.name: dancing
entities.description: What both of them do to manage stress, and the thing their friendship is built around. Jon has danced since childhood and made a business of it; Gina competed as a teenager and still dances to clear her head, including at a class with friends on 21 July 2023.

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: Jon visited on 28 January 2023 and told Gina about it the next day. Gina has never been.

entities.name: Rome
entities.description: Gina has been once, as of January 2023. Jon took a short trip there around 12 June 2023 to clear his head.

entities.name: Jon's dance crew
entities.description: The group Jon danced with before starting the studio. They took first place in a local competition in 2022, and he rehearsed with them after work.

entities.name: The Lean Startup
entities.description: The book Jon was reading on 27 May 2023 for ideas for his business. He took from it the idea of building a focused, efficient business and adapting from customer feedback.

entities.name: Gina's fashion internship
entities.description: A part-time position in the fashion department of an international company. Gina interviewed on 10 May 2023 and was accepted by 27 May 2023; she described herself as excited and nervous about the change.

claims.text: Jon lost his job as a banker on 19 January 2023.

claims.text: Gina competed in dance competitions and shows, and her team won first place at a regional competition when she was fifteen with a contemporary piece called 'Finding Freedom'.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina launched an advertising campaign for her clothing store on 29 January 2023 to grow the business.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon visited Paris on 28 January 2023; Gina has never been to Paris and has been to Rome once.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon was looking at premises for the dance studio and wanted a downtown location with good natural light, enough size, and a sprung dance floor.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon wanted Marley flooring for the dance studio because it grips, still allows movement, and is durable and easy to clean.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon found finding premises and preparing the studio both exciting and nerve-wracking, and Gina encouraged him to take breaks and dance when he needed to destress.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: By 1 February 2023 Jon was still searching for premises for the dance studio.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: A wholesaler Gina had emailed agreed to supply her on 1 February 2023, letting her expand the clothing store.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Gina designed her store's interior herself to match her own style and feel cosy, choosing comfortable furniture and a chandelier for a touch of glamour.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Gina's aim for the store is an experience that makes customers feel they are in an oasis and brings them back.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: On 4 February 2023 Gina's store was going well and Jon was still working through obstacles in his business.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Finding a location for the dance studio was the part Jon found hardest, and by 4 February 2023 he had still not found one.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon was rehearsing new routines for a dance competition near him, planned for March 2023.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon performed at the nearby festival and was complimented on his dancing by many people there.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: What Jon values most about running his own studio is the freedom to make a space where dancers of any age or level can express themselves, and watching his students progress.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina teamed up with a local artist on designs for her online store on 8 February 2023, after seeing nothing like them in a fashion magazine.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon credits taking risks with getting him out of a secure job as a banker and into trying to make a business of dancing.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina has a tattoo she got a few years before 2023 that stands for freedom — dancing without worrying what people think — and keeps it as a reminder to follow her passions.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon finds that dancing and running the business feed each other: dancing gives him energy for business goals and business progress drives him back to the floor.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon started going to the gym around 9 March 2023 to keep himself on track with the business.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Things had been hard for Gina since losing her job at DoorDash.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Gina's online clothing store opened on 16 March 2023, combining her interest in fashion trends with her love of dance.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon described losing his job as hard but said it let him live his dreams, and that starting the business had been tough.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: By 23 March 2023 Gina's online clothing store was going well and she was keeping up with fashion trends to stock it.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon's advice to Gina for running a business was to build a distinctive brand identity, build relationships with customers, and stay positive.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: What keeps Jon motivated is seeing his dance students succeed and reach their goals.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon closed his bank account on 3 April 2023 because he thought it would help the business grow, and found the change hard.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina was running new offers and promotions on her online store in April 2023 to bring in customers, and they were increasing sales.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Gina stays motivated by dance for stress relief and fashion for creativity, and combines the two by adding dance-inspired items to her store.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Gina planned to work with fashion bloggers and influencers and to advertise more, to grow her customer base.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon was expanding the studio's social media, offering workshops and classes to local schools and centres, and hosting a dance competition in May 2023 to showcase local talent.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina agreed to come to Jon's dance event.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: By 9 April 2023 Jon had put a great deal of time into the studio and his students were doing well; he said he was learning alongside them.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon said losing his job was tough but gave him the push he needed to do what he loved.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Jon used to be frightened of what people would think of his dancing and learned that his own happiness mattered more.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina took dance classes and loved spending time in the studio; Jon took lessons with friends when he was younger, and both count those memories as precious.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Gina keeps a trophy from a dance contest as a reminder of the work and the joy it brought her.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon showed his studio at a business fair on 24 April 2023, found it stressful but worthwhile, and came away with possible leads.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Gina said she started the online store to take control of her own destiny after losing her job, and called the journey tough but rewarding.
claims.speaker: Gina

claims.text: Jon was low on confidence in April 2023 and asked Gina how she stayed confident; her answer was to remember her successes, keep a support system, and remember why she started.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: On 11 May 2023 Jon was still working on the dance studio and said things were looking up.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: Both Jon and Gina describe dance as their way of de-stressing and as something they could not picture life without.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.text: What Jon wants from the studio is a place where people can dance and express themselves, which he calls a long-held dream.
claims.speaker: Jon

claims.speaker: Gina

claims.speaker: Jon

claims.speaker: Gina
